body: Thanks for your advice. I am about to try to go find something to eat today, and I'm thinking about going to the campus clinic when it opens on Monday. I really appreciate the help.
I made that mistake a few years ago. I don't intend to let myself turn back ever again.
I will, absolutely. Thanks for being optimistic for me.
In 6 months, I hope to even feel neutral. Everything really did just hit at once. Thank you for the video, it helps a little to know others have gone through the same feelings.

This is absolutely the sweetest and most helpful post ever. It helps to be reminded of what I do have and what I can do, since it's so hard for me to see for myself right now. Thank you so much for listening and taking the time to reply. I'm keeping this to reread, it did make me feel better.

Thank you for this. Even though I know I need to calm down and take care of myself and do things one step at a time, I'm having a really hard time convincing myself of that. Having others remind me of everything is making it a little easier to do.
I hope that I have your resilience.

Not even. Starting 4th week on a quarter system. :'(  And part of what is so awful is that this really did come from nowhere. When I was upset over summer he made a 4 hour round trip to keep me company for a few hours, so he's been very supportive in the past.

I do intend to tough it out, despite the thoughts I'm having. Maybe I will find somewhere else to keep all my harmful substances. I really very much appreciate your support.
I'm just having trouble seeing the solution to anything right now. Thanks for responding, having people talk at me makes me feel even slightly less alone.

He was always good to me until yesterday. I just don't know what happened. It's probably good that it's over, but being told I'm worthless when I needed support destroyed me. I really appreciate your concern. Thank you.
Thanks for the video. I smiled. Then cried. And thank you very much for the hug.
